metadata.question: Did clouds cover a larger area within a 10 km radius of Halema‘uma‘u Crater, the summit caldera of Hawaii’s Kīlauea volcano, than the volcanic plume on July 20, 2025 at 10:44 am local time?

data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Halema'uma'u Crater location
crater_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-155.28, 19.4])
roi = crater_point.buffer(10000)  # 10 km radius

# July 20, 2025, 10:44 am HST = 20:44 UTC
# Allow a small time window around this
target_date = '2025-07-20'
start_time = ee.Date('2025-07-20T20:00:00')
end_time = ee.Date('2025-07-20T22:00:00')

# 2. Data Acquisition - Try Sentinel-2 first
s2_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterBounds(roi) \
    .filterDate(start_time, end_time)

print(f"Sentinel-2 images found: {s2_col.size().getInfo()}")

# Fallback to Landsat 8/9 if Sentinel-2 has no data
if s2_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    l8_col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_TOA') \
        .filterBounds(roi) \
        .filterDate(target_date, ee.Date(target_date).advance(1, 'day'))
    l9_col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_TOA') \
        .filterBounds(roi) \
        .filterDate(target_date, ee.Date(target_date).advance(1, 'day'))
    
    combined = l8_col.merge(l9_col)
    print(f"Landsat images found: {combined.size().getInfo()}")
    
    if combined.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print("No imagery available for the specified time.")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()

# Use the available collection
col = s2_col if s2_col.size().getInfo() > 0 else combined
img = ee.Image(col.first())

# 3. Processing - Identify clouds and plume
if s2_col.size().getInfo() > 0:
    # Sentinel-2: Use QA60 for clouds
    qa = img.select('QA60')
    clouds = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11))  # Opaque and cirrus clouds
    
    # Volcanic plume detection using aerosol optical depth proxy
    # Use B1 (aerosol) and thermal contrast
    b1 = img.select('B1')
    plume = b1.gt(2000)  # High aerosol signal
else:
    # Landsat: Use BQA or simple thresholding
    # Clouds: bright in visible, cold in thermal
    clouds = img.select('B2').gt(0.3).And(img.select('B10').lt(280))
    
    # Plume: aerosol band or SO2 proxy
    plume = img.select('B1').gt(0.15)

# 4. Calculate areas
cloud_area = clouds.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry=roi,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).values().get(0)

plume_area = plume.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry=roi,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).values().get(0)

cloud_area_val = cloud_area.getInfo()
plume_area_val = plume_area.getInfo()

# 5. Validation & Final Answer
print(f"Cloud area: {cloud_area_val} sq meters")
print(f"Plume area: {plume_area_val} sq meters")

if cloud_area_val is None or plume_area_val is None:
    print("Calculation failed - invalid results")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif cloud_area_val == 0 and plume_area_val == 0:
    print("No valid pixels detected for either clouds or plume")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif cloud_area_val > plume_area_val:
    print(f"Clouds covered larger area ({cloud_area_val:.0f} vs {plume_area_val:.0f} sq m)")
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print(f"Plume covered larger or equal area ({plume_area_val:.0f} vs {cloud_area_val:.0f} sq m)")
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
